desc_en: Ne-dominant: enthusiastic, curious and imaginative, endlessly interested in people and new things. Fi-auxiliary picks out what truly moves you from all the possibilities — a natural fit for creative and people-connecting work.
desc_zh: Ne 主导：热情、好奇、脑洞大，对人和新事物充满兴趣。Fi 辅助在众多可能中捕捉真正打动自己的那一个，适合创意与连接型工作。
